rule: Before evaluations/t21r3/HOLDOUT_FROZEN no T21R3 query was sent through any runtime function: answer_knowledge, retrieve, reranker, conflict runtime, citation verifier, claim verifier, freshness router, entity gate, or the pipeline wrapper. No runtime-assisted gold QA, no coverage testing against runtime output, no BM25 tuning against holdout, no wording changes based on system output. Gold comes from fixture truth only.

checks.check: no runtime function executed on any T21R3 holdout query
checks.method: All T21R3 construction and QA steps ran only static, non-runtime code: scripts/t21r3_world.py (fixture assembly + assert_disjoint), scripts/t21r3_render_corpus.py (pure text rendering), scripts/t21r3_build_suites.py (pure row assembly with structural assertions), scripts/t21r3_static_gold_audit.py (static audit model mirroring frozen runtime mechanics, no runtime call), scripts/t21r3_uniqueness.py (set arithmetic over fixture constants and JSONL data). No call to answer_knowledge, retrieve, reranker, conflict runtime, citation verifier, claim verifier, freshness router, entity gate, or any pipeline wrapper was made against a T21R3 query.

checks.check: gold derived from fixture truth only
checks.method: Every expect_answer_contains and gold_chunk_id value in the 2214 holdout rows is computed directly from scripts/t21r3_world.py fixture structures (WorldFact / WorldTemporalFact / WorldConflict records) and from t21r3_render_corpus.py chunk ids. No gold value was read from, compared against, or corrected using any runtime output.

No BM25 parameter, tokenizer, weight, or index setting was changed at any point during T21R3 construction. The runtime and evaluator were frozen before holdout generation (runtime_freeze.json, evaluator_freeze.json) and their inputs were not touched afterwards.

checks.check: no wording changes based on system output
checks.method: All query phrasings were written up front from the frozen query-template tables. The only wording change during construction (near-duplicate province phrasing) was forced by an internal duplicate-query assertion inside scripts/t21r3_build_suites.py itself (two rows colliding within T21R3), not by any runtime output; the replacement phrasing is template-based and gold-independent.

scripts/t21r3_static_gold_audit.py uses a static audit model that re-implements only the mechanical, documented rules (tokenizer, MIN_COVERAGE=0.60, capitalized-token entity gate, guaranteed-abstain proxy) transcribed from the frozen evaluator. It executes no runtime function and its output was used only to confirm construction correctness, never to adjust gold to make answers pass.

conclusion: No blindness violation found. The T21R3 holdout remains unseen by the runtime up to the freeze point.
